contexts.text: Hence it is so often said to exalt the horn; for exaltation = power from what is interior. AE 316:5.
Her name was called Reumah () involves... exaltation, which is meant by Reumah.
Songs involved the exaltation of the Lord... on account of His victory over spiritual enemies. Gladness of heart, with the exaltation of the Lord, is what is meant by glorification.
Because exalting He hath exalted () = that He has manifested His Divine in the Human... for the Divine is the Highest... AC 8342.

I will exalt Him () = that now He has Divine worship. To exalt, when it is said of a man that he will exalt Jehovah, = worship; for Divine worship consists in the exaltation of the Lord relatively to self; which takes place according to the degree of the humiliation of self before the Lord... Whereas, it a man exalts himself in the Lord's sight, he closes the interiors of his mind against the reception of good and truth from the Lord.
This is meant by... to exalt one's self as the eagle ().
Which love is exalted by the hope of becoming an Angel.
The points and signs over the letters exalt the sense.
The life of the love is according as he had exalted his affections by means of truths... For the affections of love are exalted and perfected by means of truths...
Because a song exalts...
That songs existed for the sake of the exaltation of the life of love, and thence of the joy. Illustrated.
They are exalted according to the wisdom in the husbands.
The Angels perceive these deliciousnesses to be exalted and infilled in themselves when they ascend from chaste married partners...
As the speech was concerning marriage love, there was keen attention, and full reception, and a consequent exaltation as from the fire of love in the discourse of the Angels.
That the abundance of truths... exalts and perfects faith. TCR 351.
The exaltation of faith by means of the abundance of Truths may be illustrated by a comparison with the exaltation of the sound... from a number of musical instruments...
Thus its sense is exalted...
To exalt the paths () = to be in genuine truths; for paths = truths, which are said to be exalted from good; and the truths which are from good are genuine truths.
The God of my salvation shall be exalted () = that He is to be worshipped by means of truths from good... To be exalted, when said of God, is said of worship from good through truths.
Truth is said to be exalted when it becomes interior; in the same degree also it becomes powerful.
To set on high () = to lead to interior truths.
To set up upon a rock () = to instruct in interior truths.
